name: NewsAPI
tagline: JSON API for headlines and articles from news sources and blogs worldwide
description: NewsAPI is a REST API that returns live headlines and searchable news articles as JSON from thousands of sources and blogs. Developers authenticate with an API key and call endpoints such as top-headlines and everything to build news feeds, alerts, and media monitoring tools. Free Developer plans are for development only; production use requires a paid Business plan.

auth.details: API key via X-Api-Key header (preferred) or apiKey query parameter; self-serve signup at newsapi.org/register

pricing.free_tier_limits: Developer: 100 req/day, development/testing only (not for production); 24h article delay; search up to 1 month old; CORS localhost only
pricing.paid_plans: Business plans for production: higher volume and live articles; contact/pricing on site for commercial use

rate_limits: Developer: 100 requests per day; rate limits also apply per account/plan (see pricing)
use_cases: fetch top headlines by country or category
search recent articles by keyword or phrase
monitor news mentions of a company or product
build a personalized news feed from selected sources
power news alerts or digests in an app
